tasks.title: JIT slice 4: block formation + block-granular interpreter execution behind --block-exec
tasks.prompt: Build task implementing the jit-codegen-scope recipe. FIRST read runs/wave-13/results/jit-codegen-scope.result.json (its notes carry the measured design + recipe) and research-notes §§126/131/134/135; if the recipe is ambiguous on any point, follow ImplementationPlan §20.6 order and the §134 invalidation discipline, and record the deviation. Unit tests in the §134 style (formation boundaries, fault precision, IRQ/step transparency, verify tripwire, cap discipline).
